title: Shoggoth wall art — round 03: four-group search
notes: 48 cards, 4 independent groups x 12 (artistic / surface-aesthetic / interior-decor / structural-format) per the 2026-11-14 methodology restructure. Images are hotlinked from their original hosts, not stored in this repo. Known gaps: 3D-print marketplace refs (MakerWorld/Printables/CGTrader) bot-walled, so printed-cleat/segmented-seam cards are absent from structural; decor group light on domestic rooms (Apartment Therapy bot-walled); artistic group is Beksinski+idiom rather than shoggoth-specific fan art.

cards.title: AA78 (1978) — Zdzisław Beksiński
cards.rationale: Evan's loved reference; anchor for ochre/bone palette and fused flesh-architecture.

cards.title: Untitled (1984) — Zdzisław Beksiński
cards.rationale: Evan's liked reference; probes elongated, desiccated figure forms as relief silhouette.

cards.title: Y (2005) — Zdzisław Beksiński
cards.rationale: Probes late-period soft, vertebral mass with sparse focal detail.

cards.title: S4 (2004) — Zdzisław Beksiński
cards.rationale: Probes tall column composition for a portrait-format wall piece.

cards.title: Untitled relief (1957) — Zdzisław Beksiński
cards.rationale: Beksiński's own sculptural relief; direct precedent for a printable low-relief surface.

cards.title: Angel of Death / Beksinski-Hommage — Marcus Propostus
cards.rationale: Probes near-black, hooded vertical figure in a decayed gothic cavity; value-range reference.

cards.title: 52 Cirith Ungol (Beksinski study) — docchannard
cards.rationale: Probes eroded rock-as-architecture and ochre-grey haze for the background mass.

cards.title: Beksinski Inspiration — Bolzak
cards.rationale: Probes saturated ochre ground with a stringy, flayed standing figure.

cards.title: Cosmic Horror Creature Ink Drawing — demonic666evil
cards.rationale: OUTLIER (pen and ink): dense mouth/tentacle all-over texture; tests monochrome shoggoth surface density.

cards.title: Takiyasha the Witch and the Skeleton Spectre — Utagawa Kuniyoshi
cards.rationale: OUTLIER (ukiyo-e): giant-scale monster rendered in flat line and colour; tests graphic-flat shoggoth mass.

cards.title: The Eagle of Doom (Apocalypse Tapestry, Angers) — Nicolas Bataille / Jean Bondol
cards.rationale: OUTLIER (14th-c. woven tapestry): medieval beast in flat woven fields; tests textile/relief-like flatness.

cards.title: Medieval Cthulhu Leaded Stained Glass — AutobotWonko
cards.rationale: OUTLIER (leaded glass): hard-outline segmented panels; tests segmentation-as-aesthetic for the print splits.

cards.title: Beksinski 1983: webbed cathedral facade
cards.rationale: Does lace-like calcified webbing relief in a single burnt-orange hue read as skin at 1 m, or too busy/gothic?

cards.title: Beksinski 1984: mummified ochre flesh
cards.rationale: Is dried-hide ochre-to-umber with soft matte finish the target body surface (caption bar in scan to be ignored)?

cards.title: Beksinski 1971: bone field, olive-ochre crust
cards.rationale: Does a murky olive/ochre bone-crust palette with heavy impasto hold up as a matte print finish?

cards.title: Dried mud-crack polygons, tidal flat
cards.rationale: Cracked-earth skin: is a polygonal craze network at ~1-5 cm cell size a viable printed surface?

cards.title: Flowstone drapery, Saracen's Tent, Luray
cards.rationale: Calcified webbing: do vertical translucent-cream drapery ribs give the right wet-then-petrified read?

cards.title: Rust on iron, oxide gradient
cards.rationale: Rust-and-bone gradient: does flaking oxide orange grading to pale substrate suit a hand-painted PLA finish?

cards.title: Brain coral (Favites abdita)
cards.rationale: Brain-coral ridging: is meandering ridge-and-valley relief the preferred micro-texture over cracks?

cards.title: Verdigris streaks on bronze (Neptune fountain)
cards.rationale: Verdigris patina: does teal oxide running down ochre-brown metal work as accent over the base palette?

cards.title: Raku tea bowl, crazed pale glaze, carbon-dark base
cards.rationale: OUTLIER dry/mineral: would raku crackle glaze with smoked-carbon gradient suit a ceramic-look finish?

cards.title: Barnacle colony (Chthamalus stellatus)
cards.rationale: OUTLIER organic/matte: is a dense colony of small calcite cones a usable scale-pattern for the skin?

cards.title: Maki-e gold on black urushi lacquer
cards.rationale: OUTLIER wet/gloss: does deep black lacquer gloss with fine gold line detail suit the mask or accent areas?

cards.title: Metallic scarab shell (Chrysina resplendens)
cards.rationale: OUTLIER gloss/organic: would a mirror-metallic chitin finish work as a small bright counterpoint to matte decay?

cards.title: Julia DeVille gothic home, Melbourne
cards.rationale: Does dark taxidermy-and-macabre art read as a collected home rather than a haunted-house set, and at what density?

cards.title: Domestic cabinet-of-curiosities room
cards.rationale: How does a 1 m organic wall piece sit among dense collected objects instead of on a bare wall?

cards.title: Paris salon, dark green velvet and art
cards.rationale: Dark saturated palette plus sofa-scale art: wall piece must hold against upholstery and window light.

cards.title: Giger Museum Bar, Gruyeres, wide interior
cards.rationale: Architecture-scale biomechanical ribbing: what happens when the creature is the room, not an object on the wall.

cards.title: Giger Museum Bar, Gruyeres, seating detail
cards.rationale: Furniture and wall share one bone-colored organic language; tests whether sofa/lamp must echo the piece.

cards.title: Giger Bar ceiling vault
cards.rationale: Overhead and wall-plane vertebral forms under low warm light: lighting direction for relief sculpture.

cards.title: Deep Bar, Ukraine, root-draped ceiling and raw masonry
cards.rationale: Dark tangled organic mass against rough wall with a single lit sign: how much light a dark piece needs to read.

cards.title: Le Poisson Volant, red-lit Paris restaurant
cards.rationale: Single-hue colored lighting as a way to make a dark piece glow at night.

cards.title: OUTLIER: Japanese house with cave-like voids cut through walls
cards.rationale: Organic cavity in a plain Japanese house: a subtractive foil to an additive wall creature.

cards.title: OUTLIER: Tokyo minimal apartment, tiled volume and bare walls
cards.rationale: Japanese-minimal negative space: does one grotesque piece need blank wall and few competing objects?

cards.title: OUTLIER: Kids-room whale mural in progress
cards.rationale: Friendly-creature mural scale: soften the Shoggoth toward a family-room read?

cards.title: OUTLIER: Butter Baby, Jakarta, yellow alien-habitat shop
cards.rationale: Kitsch/pop inversion: same biomorphic curves in cheerful yellow; probes happy-mask colorway.

cards.title: Rodin, Gates of Hell (high relief in a door frame)
cards.rationale: High relief that pushes figures out of a rectangular architectural frame: how deep can the body go before the back plate needs ribs and cleats?

cards.title: Ghiberti, Gates of Paradise (bas-relief panel)
cards.rationale: Bas-relief depth class with perspective compression: floor option for a flat-back tentacle field.

cards.title: Gillie and Marc bronze octopus, WTC Oculus
cards.rationale: Tentacled creature gripping architecture at 36 ft: arch/column-merging format and where tentacle tips take load.

cards.title: Huang Yong Ping, Wu Zei (octopus wrapping gallery)
cards.rationale: Tentacles reaching meters from body across ceiling, poles and beams: multi-point freeform spread with mixed wall/ceiling anchors.

cards.title: Cloud Gate, welded plate seams
cards.rationale: Segmentation seam strategy: large form built from plates with seams ground flush versus seams expressed.

cards.title: Jackalope wall decoration, plaque mount
cards.rationale: Trophy-plaque format: single proud head on a small backplate with a hanger, creature as mounted specimen.

cards.title: Antlers covering an auditorium wall, Naturalis
cards.rationale: Outlier: antler/taxidermy mount hardware as a repeated point-mount array; many small anchors instead of three big ones.

cards.title: Pavel Rotts, climbing-wall installation
cards.rationale: Outlier: climbing-hold aesthetic and T-nut style bolt grid as a rated, repositionable mount system for tentacle terminations.

cards.title: Bouldering wall with volumes and holds
cards.rationale: Outlier: sculpted volumes bolted to a wall as proven large-scale, load-rated, modular relief hardware.

cards.title: Calder mobile (articulated hanging form)
cards.rationale: Outlier: articulated/kinetic limbs hung from single pivots; could a tentacle tip pivot instead of bolt?

cards.title: Tensegrity structure
cards.rationale: Outlier: tension-cable mount; compression struts floating on cables could carry tentacle load into wall anchors with minimal printed mass.

cards.title: Marrakech tessellated tile wall
cards.rationale: Outlier: modular tile system; body as repeating tiles with interlocking edges, seams hidden in pattern.
